description: Claim (activate) an inspected preview as a live site at {slug}.worldsite.workers.dev. This is the paid go-live step ($1 USDC first 30 days); publish_website only returns the plan and never goes live by itself. Call preview_status first — if claimable is false, do not pay. Ask which slug they want before paying. Live URL is {slug}.worldsite.workers.dev — not {slug}.workers.dev. Pretty names: CNAME their domain after claim. uploadId MUST be the UUID from inspect (not previewUrl). If you only have https://publish.sornkan.com/preview/<uuid>, pass that UUID. If you have no wallet, get payment_url from the 402 response and show it to the human — they pay by card or Thai PromptPay in THB (no crypto needed); after they pay, poll preview_status/retry until live. If the last claim returned PRICE_COMPUTE_FAILED, retry this tool — no USDC was taken. If a signed payment failed settlement, tell the human contact@sornkan.com and do not retry payment.

editToken.description: Edit token of a site paid by card/PromptPay (shown once at claim and emailed to the payer). Required to edit/renew/connect a domain on such a site.

slug.description: Lowercase site name to claim; live URL is {slug}.worldsite.workers.dev (ask the human first)

uploadId.description: UUID from inspect — the part after /preview/, never the full preview URL
